items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 18 at 11:29AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
Heavy rain and strong winds are expected to start later today and
last
through the weekend as multiple strong low pressure systems move
into the northern gulf. These lows will bring multiple days of
moderate to heavy rain, with around 1.5 to 3 inches of rain every 24
hours. Some areas, especially near Yakutat and along the gulf coast,
could see localized areas reach around 4 inches of rain in 24 hours.
Heaviest rain rates are anticipated late Saturday into Sunday with
hourly rates of 0.15 to 0.3

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued September 18 at 6:43AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Upper Kuskokwim Valley

River levels on the Kuskokwim River at McGrath may still rise this
afternoon in response to the heavy rain earlier this week. The
Kuskokwim has leveled out around 18.5ft as of 6 AM AKDT Friday
morning, there is a chance for it to rise back up to near bankfull
later today or tonight. If the river looks to drop, this will be the
last update.
